findings.test: buildFullDraft fixture used by draft teardown survival invariant
findings.evidence: Static inference from fixture and production types/callers: buildFullDraft seeds all four BoundingBox coordinates as 1 or 9. BoundingBox.ts documents coordinates normalized 0–1 relative to the source image, and useActiveCatFlow persists normalized cropProjection output. The store accepts these values without validation, so this is technically seedable but not a state produced by annotation. Since this case only asserts persisted-state teardown, the out-of-range values do not invalidate the teardown regression itself.
findings.changes: No repository edits; report only. Use a valid normalized box, e.g. lower-left (0.1, 0.9), upper-right (0.9, 0.1), if this fixture is revised.
findings.remaining_risk: The test is about clearing persisted content rather than geometry; the unrealistic values do not materially weaken that assertion.
findings.flaw_details: Draft teardown fixture uses normalized box coordinates outside [0,1] (1 and 9). This state is not produced by the crop projection/annotation path, though the store permits it and teardown does not interpret geometry.

summary: Reviewed all 18 in-scope domain and utility test files against production modules, types, and callers. One low-impact invalid fixture found in draft teardown setup; remaining scenarios match reachable inputs or documented behavior. Static review only; tests were not run.
